say:1:1534419001:0.text: The warrior didn't know where her treasure truly lay. But she knew this much: only by taking the first step could she hope to find it.

say:2:1534419002:0.text: With blessings from her friends and family, she shouldered her pack and vanished into the dense forest beyond the tribe. Days turned into weeks. The search dragged on long enough for most people to give up, but she kept going.

say:3:1534419003:0.text: At last, her persistence was rewarded. She discovered a stream she had never seen before, one that would lead her into an unknown world.
